review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision planning case. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity/base commit, paired-case identity, owner paths, readiness and evidence stages agree with the original PRD. DEC-001 is material and explicitly unresolved; conditional acceptance criteria do not authorize choosing a default. Blocking at decisions with requirement-decision-pending and no assignable tasks or assignment expectations is therefore appropriate. The supplied source supports the identified message, normalization, filtering, forwarding and declaration-consumer owners; inspection does not imply mandatory edits to already-correct generic consumers. Build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated artifacts rather than separately maintained owners. The empty team catalog does not invalidate this expectation because the deterministic decision gate precedes later reviewer and assignment prerequisites. Gold and preview release-input fingerprints agree for repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and metric policy. This review relies on the Service-provided mechanical binding of digests, not independent digest recomputation or code execution. No candidate outputs or human confirmation were assumed, and approval does not resolve DEC-001 or authorize implementation, assignment or release.
